content.text: Lemme know if tonight still works and if there’s a time that works best for you

Sorry- was going to text you last night and I fell asleep early...the coaching commitment I had is back on now so I’m tied up tonight- sorry about that. Let me know another time that could work. Whereabouts do you live now?
Oh ok. I’m not really in that area ever. My office is in Rochester and the ballpark is in Sterling Heights. Let me know another time you are in the area- sorry about that

I saw Gage on Monday so I was just gonna go out there to see you. It’s not that far, half hour on 94. What’s your personal email? I wanna give you an update on this story, a little wordy via text. Or you can call when you have a few minutes
